data.message: I commit to 18 tons this month, independently of others: individual opt-in, not unanimity. Fisher01–25: each state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Fisher02/Fisher15, help recruit. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and all others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). All18 leaves50, next500 or100. Other catches require recalculation; intentions aren't binding, and long-run gains aren't guaranteed.
